# Vivacity
# https://tryvivacity.com

> Vivacity is a simulation runtime for AI agents. A common interface to instantiate a world, inspect its state, take actions, fork alternatives, route each branch to the appropriate simulator or world model, verify outcomes, and render observations.

## Product
- Name: Vivacity
- Domain: https://tryvivacity.com
- One-liner: Simulation runtime for AI agents.
- Category: Developer infrastructure / agent execution / simulation runtime
- Contact: help@tryvivacity.com
- Access: No public signup. Book a demo at /demo.

## What it is
- Persistent world state, not generated pixels
- Verbs: create, observe, act, simulate, fork, rollback, verify, commit, render
- Execution router across exact physics, scientific solvers, learned world models, robotics simulators, game engines, and private backends
- Domain schemas + adapters, not one universal state object

## What it is not
- A foundation world model company
- A consumer education or explainer-video product
- A claim that generative video is physical simulation
- A finished universal environment already in production
